chat.say: Humne toh pehle hi kaha tha ki sona mat lo!
Ab samajh aaya, mummy hamesha sahi hoti hain.

data.asar: Sona bach gaya, ab wahi paise party mein udhenge.
data.caption:
Gold ke daam par aayi nayi khabar!

• PM Modi ne di thi salah
• Sona na kharidne ki appeal
• Karobariyon ne bheja dhanyawad patr

Save kar lo, baad mein kaam aayega!

Dost ko tag karo jiske paas gold ki kami hai.
